fix.redesign: Keep key, label, unit and tol; re-case the capstone input so the value is not printed in the lessons or on the default panel state.

fields.recommendation: Every graded value of all three reservoircalc capstones is printed in that tier's own capstone walkthrough lesson (the Associate one as a table of field, value and tolerance) and in earlier lessons, and every panel opens on the capstone case. Re-case the capstones on a contact, fault position or well set the lessons do not work (fields, units and tolerances can stay), or accept these as open-book reading checks and say so in the course. Tolerances and displays are otherwise sound.
fields.evidence: Integer count printed as an integer; tol 0 is honest for a count. 169 of 500 cells is not a guessable space. fields.notes: Probe default state prints 'Oil-bearing cells 169 of 500'.
